scope: Allocation-free, feature-gated wire codecs in the existing Rust host module; no bus/device attachment or runtime-owner replacement

wire_codecs.group: Bounded400u32 array,1..32 ordered commands,full epoch/generation/u64 identities/revisions/deadline; no split/reorder/effective-frame resolution
wire_codecs.commands: All five ordinary kinds,switch and restricted stateless refusals; original finite f32 gain bits plus exact Fixed conversion; invalid nonfinite values precede missing binding; refused switches keep kind5
wire_codecs.result: Exact size/version/count/epoch/sequence and known codes; normal header refusals retain every position; fault/uncertainty preserves known prefix and diagnostic Unprocessed without fake fenced success
wire_codecs.snapshot: Borrowed complete packet,exact explicit geometry/identity/header and row reserved bits; max19520bytes/128physical rows; raw render and next cursors/original gain/failure/u64pulse/validity/skips preserved
wire_codecs.initial_rows: Revision0/F0/sequence1 header has no graph members; retained arbitrary raw validity/gain bits do not grant membership or restoration

verification.interop_limits: Existing RTL consumer and snapshot producer; delayed consumer completion uses qualified component handoff input,not actual DDR fence or new ARM MMIO transport. Existing actual-DDR/hardware-paced suites pass separately. Fault/uncertainty packet decoding includes golden fixtures,not a claim current retained-fault banks publish complete packets.
verification.default_linux_limits: Default Linux feature set does not replace the explicit optional-feature simulation/codec matrix

retained_failed_iterations.cause: Golden fixture typed0x53464631 instead of frozen0x53434631; encoder was already correct; corrected expected literal without weakening assertion
Nix exposes direct Cargo,which rejects +toolchain syntax before compilation; explicit rustup run plus installed pinned RUSTC passes

reproduce_narrow: nix develop --command bash -c 'export SHOOP_FPGA_SOURCE_ROOT="$PWD"; RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo test -p rt_fpga_rtl --features sim,rt-interface --test semantic_codec --test semantic_groups --test snapshots -- --test-threads=1'
